closures.title: Dashboard placeholder omitted truthful owner state
closures.root_cause: The endpoint returned a static shell instead of aggregating completed tenant-scoped domains

closures.title: Merchant owner lacked a safe lifecycle directory
closures.root_cause: The only staff read exposed HR-owned operational data and correctly denied Merchant Admin
closures.fix: Narrow tenant-safe membership projection under existing lifecycle authority

closures.title: Merchant canonical routes and left-navigation placement were incomplete
closures.root_cause: Legacy prefixed routes and generic shell predated the role-specific host contract
closures.fix: Canonical 15-route tree, grouped left shell, responsive rail/drawer and 8 inert Gate W entries
closures.regression: navigation component tests plus focused browser

closures.title: Contextual detail route did not mark its parent navigation item current
closures.root_cause: Active-state traversal inspected only direct navigation nodes

closures.title: Small orange eyebrow labels failed AA contrast
closures.root_cause: Brand primary was used as body-sized semantic text on the light surface
closures.fix: Use the approved muted text token
closures.regression: 15 light axe scans plus representative dark scans

closures.title: Recovered parallel suite exposed stale generated and phase consumers
closures.root_cause: The setup route, UI-08 corrective matrix, Phase 23 in-flight marker and OpenAPI projection still encoded the predecessor UI-08 state after canonical UI-09 activation
closures.fix: Reconcile each consumer to the current canonical route/status source and regenerate OpenAPI from that source
closures.regression: Corrected full parallel suite: 2,971 passed, 14 skipped, 0 failed, 48,712 assertions

closures.title: Clean full Playwright startup exceeded the fixed web-server timeout
closures.root_cause: The gate allowed 120 seconds for the mandatory vue-tsc plus Vite production build, while a clean local build requires more than two minutes; the focused run had reused an already-running preview
closures.fix: Raise only the Playwright web-server startup ceiling to 600 seconds
closures.regression: Full Playwright must start its own production preview and complete

closures.title: Merchant desktop shell nested two primary-navigation landmarks
closures.root_cause: AppShell wrapped HeaderGroupNavigation's own labelled nav in a second labelled nav element
closures.fix: Keep the shell container and test marker as a neutral div while HeaderGroupNavigation remains the single navigation landmark
closures.regression: Phase 23 unique-landmark check plus focused UI-09 axe and shell suite

closures.title: Predecessor E2E consumers asserted retired Merchant paths and hid truthful gated state
closures.root_cause: Phase 6/11/20/UI-08 tests still expected the prefixed setup/owner routes, manual completion for server-observed checklist items, a consolidated compensation screen, no Wallet wording anywhere, and /dashboard to be absent on the Merchant host
closures.fix: Assert canonical /setup and /dashboard transitions, server-observed disabled checklist state, split summary/approval pages, inert Gate W links with no href, and the Merchant-owned dashboard collision
closures.regression: Seven affected tests pass with equal-or-stronger protected-property assertions

closures.title: Whole-product release audit did not understand the UI-09 screen and breakpoint contract
closures.root_cause: The Phase 23 matrix treated every sidebar role below 1024 as mobile, omitted six newly live screens, used legacy Merchant routes, and supplied the pre-logo-history profile response
closures.fix: Assert the tablet rail from 768 through 1024, enroll all live inventory keys at canonical routes, and update the profile fixture without weakening overflow, theme, axe or persistence checks
closures.regression: Coverage, representative responsive, unique landmark, 200-percent zoom and deterministic profile checks pass

closures.title: Owner surfaces were functionally correct but visually flat and generic
closures.root_cause: Dashboard, checklist, branch directory and subscription surfaces reused equally weighted neutral cards, obscuring owner hierarchy and leaving large desktop areas without purposeful composition
closures.fix: Introduce brand/status accents, a dominant subscription summary, warm progress treatment, clearer owner labels and denser branch portfolio cards without changing authority or fabricating metrics
closures.regression: Regenerated 15-page visual catalogue plus 65-case focused Playwright across light/dark, seven widths and 200-percent zoom

closures.title: Final Larastan could not prove the staff-history timestamp type
closures.root_cause: StaffHistory intentionally has created_at only, but its model PHPDoc omitted the nullable Carbon property declared by the nullable timestamp schema
closures.fix: Annotate the existing created_at attribute as Carbon|null; no schema or runtime behavior changed
closures.regression: Larastan level 8: 1,437 analyzed, 0 errors; affected API file: 5 passed, 32 assertions

closures.title: A test-written UI-01 proof refresh survived the historical cleanup
closures.root_cause: The aggregate baseline protects docs/frontend/audits directories but does not cover docs/proof/ui-01/network/browser-evidence.json, so a prior full-suite refresh containing refused localhost requests and pre-fix document-head errors was outside its comparison
closures.fix: Restore that one generated historical proof file byte-for-byte from the verified UI-09 base; preserve all current UI-07 projections and UI-09 evidence
closures.regression: The path has zero diff from b435f484; final scope review and git diff check are clean

closures.title: UI-06 generated public-route projection was stale at the initial PR head
closures.root_cause: The historical-evidence restoration correctly preserved frozen UI-06 proof but also restored public-route-matrix.json, which is a current generated projection of the canonical route modules and therefore had to advance with UI-09
closures.fix: Regenerate the UI-06 artifacts from the canonical route source; the only changed generated consumer is public-route-matrix.json
closures.regression: UI-06 generator --check, UI-09 audit check and navigation check pass; Ui06GeneratedArtifactStalenessTest passes its runnable assertions

closures.title: UI-06 landing contract encoded the retired setup route and alias direction
closures.root_cause: The predecessor contract keyed the setup route as onboarding.first-time-setup and expected /setup to be its alias, while UI-09 canonically owns merchant.setup at /setup and retains /onboarding/first-time-setup only as compatibility
closures.fix: Assert /setup as the canonical absolute path and the predecessor onboarding path as merchant.setup's alias; registration and one-implementation invariants remain intact
closures.regression: Ui06LandingContractTest: 46 passed, 2,024 assertions; focused Pint clean; exact-head Backend CI required
